cases.assertion: aliases, reexports, project references preserve supported binding; dynamic JS any remains unknown; malicious plugin is not executed
same route path in different services is not linked without explicit source evidence
decorators and dynamic imports remain bounded; target is not imported or executed
cell, venv and config side effects do not execute; missing metadata stays a gap
dialect-specific dynamic SQL lineage stays evidence-bound; deployment is not inferred
local refs are bounded; remote refs, cycles and mismatches do not trigger network or false handlers
same topic across broker/environment boundaries is not bridged; retry/ack/replay are preserved
only approved scoped guards/actions are represented; stale sources invalidate and guards do not execute
stale/denied/missing members remain partial with provenance and no namespace leakage
rename/provider changes are not force-matched; missing snapshots remain explicit
reserve/retry/partial-fill/cancel/ledger fixture yields obligations without money or finality inference
duplicate/out-of-order webhook and partial refund preserve distinct order/payment/stock states
metadata drift is reported without loading models/datasets or calling an LLM
allowed and forbidden witnesses are exact; missing coverage cannot yield whole-system PASS
baseline/full/incremental reports separate synthetic from real and include correct failure/recall denominators

oracle: independently authored expected facts and acceptance assertions; engine output is never its own oracle
source_mode: synthetic fixtures only; no user repository was authorized for this benchmark
